g.text: Warm · point-in-time, fed forward · daily / monthly

div.p: Mix-and-match cadence — every tier publishes independently into one Lakebase online store; the model's FeatureLookups assemble across all of them at serving time. Pick the cheapest compute per tier: scheduled serverless jobs for daily/monthly/hourly, 30-s streaming only for burst counters. Feed forward — events use the last completed daily/monthly period until the next backfill.
